answer: A bond is refunded only after 32 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The walnut counter is kept in tundra and tide shows each reset. An adversary therefore has to keep every alias continuously active for 32 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 3460 identities would post 3649 proofs and burn roughly 69 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
